title: PIN-core-db-separation: Separate the core from QNFO's research database
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** trigger: pilot milestone 1
**Done check:** file:docs/migrations/core-db-split.json
**Status:** open

The core still shares a database with QNFO's other applications. Done when the split migration and its verification record are committed.

Source: site/pins.json (SITE-PINS-1); the public /engineers and /roadmap pages render this item, and scripts/build_site_roadmap.py --check fails when the claim and the item drift.
